# Textual（Hermes vendored copy）

This directory contains the source-local copy of [Textual](https://github.com/gonzalezreal/textual), version **0.5.0**, upstream revision:

`01b51875a5406eefc95f52a058cb059e7bc94dc4`

Textual is a SwiftUI rich-text and Markdown rendering library. The upstream project README and full usage guide are maintained by the upstream project; consult the [README at the pinned revision](https://github.com/gonzalezreal/textual/blob/01b51875a5406eefc95f52a058cb059e7bc94dc4/README.md) rather than copying that manual into this repository.

## Local maintenance

- [`LICENSE`](LICENSE): upstream MIT license and copyright notice. Keep it with the vendored source.
- [`HERMES-PATCHES.md`](HERMES-PATCHES.md): rationale and scope of Hermes-specific source changes.
- [`patches/README.md`](patches/README.md): how to reapply and verify the 17 local patches.
- [`UPSTREAM-SHA256.json`](UPSTREAM-SHA256.json): pinned upstream and local file digests.

Do not replace this directory with a newer upstream version or discard local changes without comparing the pinned revision, patch set and application behavior.
